interest: Japan's 1941 demands for bases in southern Indochina.
overview: Two cross-references (May and July 1941) on Japanese demands for bases in southern Indochina.

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet for a telegram from Chungking reporting Chinese Foreign Office intelligence on Japanese military demands for air and naval bases in Indochina and troop landings at Saigon.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference: Japan demands bases and landing rights at Saigon, May 1941.
subfiles.title: Cross-reference sheet for Telegram No. 180 from Chungking on Japanese demands for air and naval bases in Indochina

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet for a telegram from Ambassador Joseph C. Grew in Tokyo transmitting British intelligence regarding Japanese demands on France for bases in French Indochina.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Grew's telegram on Japanese base demands in Indochina, July 1941.
subfiles.title: Cross-reference sheet for Telegram No. 1006 from Tokyo on Japanese demands for bases in French Indochina
